name: logical-research
description: Scan a question or Pack a bounded corpus into reusable, traceable context with evidence-graded claims.

interface.shortDescription: Scan a question or Pack a corpus into traceable context
interface.longDescription: Scan a question or a small source set into one graded file, or Pack a bounded corpus end to end into evidence-graded synthesis, per-item notes, and a traceable bibliography.
interface.defaultPrompt: Research this bounded corpus and build reusable context from it.
